description_long:
EOI - Malawi - Provision of Training in Road Construction and Maintenance - SADC SRTTFP
11-Nov-2024
The services included under this assignment are, but not limited to:
Provision of different types of training services related to road construction and maintenance
Transfer knowledge and skills to youths and women through training related to road construction sector or subsectors.
Provision of preliminary training for women and the youth aimed at building their confidence to take up jobs during construction and operation of the road.
